ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Employer and insurer contracts, Proposal and later stages need Amount, Pricing model and Contract term (months).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Employer_insurer_contracts", CASE(StageName, "Qualified", 1, "Discovery", 2, "Proposal", 3, "Governance review", 4, "Pilot", 5, "Contract out", 6, "Closed won", 7, 0) >= 3, OR(ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(TEXT(Pricing_model__c)), ISBLANK(Contract_term_months__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Amount, Pricing model and Contract term (months) before moving to Proposal.
